result:
result: Both new tests are correct, and the DetachedHead hint and hooks.md items match the code. No blockers. `currentBranch` in `vcs/git.ts` does have the same same-named-tag bug.

checks: `bun test packages/runtime/tests/cloud-checkout.test.ts` -> 10 pass, 0 fail, 96 expect() calls. I also reproduced the tag behavior of `symbolic-ref` in a scratch repo outside the checkout.

blockers: none

findings:
The tag fix is correct. In my scratch repo with branch and tag `feat/x`, `symbolic-ref --short -q HEAD` printed `heads/feat/x` and the plain form printed `refs/heads/feat/x`. `status.ts:76-79` strips `refs/heads/`, which handles this.
The fallback-branch silence at `status.ts:82` is intended by the brief. It only changes the result when the start branch is refused and the checkout already sits on the fallback, so `git switch main` would be a no-op. If start is undefined, the earlier return already applies. A detached HEAD still shows the notice, because `current === undefined` never equals `branch`.
The DetachedHead hint at `errors.ts:125-126` is correct and appears in both dist bundles. The `<path>` placeholder and the cloud-first wording are optional polish.
`docs/hooks.md:28` is accurate. The five commands it lists are exactly the ones the code runs (`rev-parse`, `symbolic-ref`, `reflog`, `show-ref`, `check-ref-format`).
I rejected the built-in review's finding about `current === branch` hiding a real move. It is the deliberate trade-off the brief asked for, and the docs state it. I also rejected its finding on non-`refs/heads` symbolic HEADs as too contrived to matter. Its test-gap and hint-wording findings are optional at most.
No regression: the notice's existing branches are unchanged apart from the reordered `returnBranch` call, and the earlier tests still pass.

notes:
`currentBranch` at `vcs/git.ts:85` still uses `symbolic-ref --short`. With a same-named tag it returns `heads/<name>`, and `check-ref-format --branch` accepts that. `commit.ts` and `pr.ts` would then get a wrong branch name (`heads/<name>`). This is outside this commit; it needs its own fix and test.
`status.ts` `returnBranch` uses `--short` on `refs/remotes/origin/HEAD`. It has an unlikely tag-collision case, optional.
